parameters: The North Gate is barred with iron and frozen shut.
Beyond it the pass climbs into the snow toward Arulustus.
The North Gate is barred with iron and frozen shut.
Beyond it the pass climbs into the snow toward Arulustus.
A soldier at the door: "Lord Commander Talonheart is in council. Wait your turn."
Candles burn for those who did not come back from the border.
Sacks of grain and barrels of lamp oil, stacked to the rafters.
Someone inside is singing very badly about a goat.
An old soldier's helmet hangs by the door. Nobody answers.
Children's mittens are drying on the windowsill.
Warm straw, and horses stamping in the dark.
A clerk calls out: "Guild business after the festival bell!"
FROSTHOLLOW BRANCH - open requests:
"Wolves on the south road." "Missing goat." "Escort wanted: north pass (CANCELLED)."
An axe is buried in the chopping block by the door. Nobody home.
A dog barks once behind the door, then thinks better of it.
"By order of the garrison: no one passes the North Gate."
"Lost: one goat. Answers to nothing. Last seen at the Frozen Flagon."
Simple stones, each with a name and a date. Too many share the same year.
\C[6]Gate Guard:\C[0]
Welcome to Frosthollow - last town before the pass.
Mind the ice on the stairs. And the soldiers. Mostly the ice.
\C[6]Guard:\C[0]
No one goes north. Loyalist raiders have been seen on the pass.
\C[6]Guard:\C[0]
Orders from the Lord Commander himself. The gate stays shut.
\C[6]Recruit:\C[0]
Hyah! ...These dummies never fall over.
The sergeant says that's the point.
\C[6]Priest:\C[0]
Every name on these stones kept the pass for us.
Light a candle if you have someone out there.
\C[6]Quartermaster:\C[0]
Grain for the winter, oil for the lamps, arrows for the walls.
And every crate counted twice. The Commander counts the third time.
\C[6]Old Ingrid:\C[0]
Sixty winters I've hung an ornament on that tree.
This year mine is a little silver bell - for the boys at the border.
I built the snowman! His name is Sir Frost.
He guards the square. Like the soldiers, but colder.
\C[6]Hilda:\C[0]
Even a smith needs a holiday.
Tomorrow I'll fix your blade. Today, I fix cider.
\C[6]Regular:\C[0]
The goat? Oh, the goat is fine.
The goat is better than fine. The goat is in charge now.
\C[6]Girl:\C[0]
The pond froze solid last night!
Mother says I can skate when the ice sings.
\C[6]Fur Merchant:\C[0]
Furs, mittens, boots! Nothing keeps you warmer!
...except maybe the cider.
\C[6]Little Girl:\C[0]
Papa was a captain. He's coming home after the snow.
Mama says so. Mama says it every night.
\C[6]Stable Hand:\C[0]
The garrison horses eat better than I do.
Fair, mind. They work harder.
The horse snorts a cloud of steam at you.
The horse snorts a cloud of steam at you.
The husky shakes snow all over you.
